anchors.phonological_note: ケツ undergoes common 促音化 to けっ before 定.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 決定（けってい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Reuse the scene in 決定（けってい）; its On sound is ケツ and its meaning is “decision.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 決める（きめる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Keep the semantic image, then recall the complete word 決める（きめる）—“to decide.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 決まる（きまる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Kun きまる lives in the full lexeme 決まる（きまる）: “to be decided.”

anchors.phonological_note: After the sokuon in しゅっ, ハツ surfaces as ぱつ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 出発（しゅっぱつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Attach ハツ to the semantic scene through 出発（しゅっぱつ）—“departure.”
